title_clean: Skype Session on Bhante Bodhidhamma's 70th Birthday
description_short: A warm celebration of Bhante Bodhidhamma's 70th birthday with students worldwide sharing gratitude, memories, and reflections on his 30-year teaching journey.
description_long:
In this heartwarming birthday celebration, Bhante Bodhidhamma connects via Skype with students from around the world, including groups in Brighton, Dublin, West Kerry, and beyond. The session captures intimate reflections on his spiritual journey, including his early struggles reconciling Christianity and Buddhism, his discovery of the Dhamma in Sri Lanka, and his 30 years establishing Satipañña Buddhist Retreat.

Bhante shares profound insights on interfaith understanding, describing how he came to see Christ's teachings through a Buddhist lens - viewing the bread and wine as metaphors for sati (awareness) and paññā (wisdom). He reflects candidly on the challenges of being a lone Western monk, his moments of wanting to disrobe, and what kept him committed to the monastic path.

Students share touching memories and express gratitude for Bhante's humor, wisdom, and compassionate teaching style. The celebration includes the presentation of generous donations totaling £7,070.70 for his upcoming pilgrimage to Japan, where he plans to visit Dōgen's original monastery. This intimate glimpse into a beloved teacher's life offers inspiration for practitioners at all stages of the path, demonstrating how the Dhamma transforms both teacher and students through decades of dedicated practice.
